Simulate mechanism performance under realistic network conditions

Usage: commonware-estimator [OPTIONS] --distribution <distribution> <task>

Arguments:
  <task>  Path to .lazy file defining the simulation behavior

Options:
      --distribution <distribution>  Distribution of peers across regions:
                                     <region>:<count> (unlimited bandwidth)
                                     <region>:<count>:<egress>/<ingress> (asymmetric)
                                     <region>:<count>:<bandwidth> (symmetric)
                                     
                                     Bandwidth is in bytes per second.
                                     
                                     Examples:
                                     us-east-1:3 (3 peers, unlimited bandwidth)
                                     us-east-1:3:1000/500 (1000 B/s egress, 500 B/s ingress)
                                     eu-west-1:2:2000 (2000 B/s both ways)
      --reload                       Reload latency data from cloudping.co
  -h, --help                         Print help
  -V, --version                      Print version
